  COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS total_customers,

WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    oi.brand,
    o.order_date,
    oi.unit_price_eur * oi.quantity AS line_revenue_eur
  FROM luxexperience.order_items oi
  JOIN luxexperience.orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  WHERE oi.returned = FALSE
)
SELECT
  brand,
  SUM(CASE WHEN order_date >= DATE '2024-06-29' AND order_date < DATE '2025-06-30' THEN line_revenue_eur ELSE 0 END) AS obs_revenue_eur,
  SUM(CASE WHEN order_date >= DATE '2023-06-29' AND order_date < DATE '2024-06-29' THEN line_revenue_eur ELSE 0 END) AS comp_revenue_eur,
  SUM(CASE WHEN order_date >= DATE '2024-06-29' AND order_date < DATE '2025-06-30' THEN line_revenue_eur ELSE 0 END)
    - SUM(CASE WHEN order_date >= DATE '2023-06-29' AND order_date < DATE '2024-06-29' THEN line_revenue_eur ELSE 0 END) AS abs_change_eur,
  CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN order_date >= DATE '2023-06-29' AND order_date < DATE '2024-06-29' THEN line_revenue_eur ELSE 0 END) = 0 THEN NULL
       ELSE (SUM(CASE WHEN order_date >= DATE '2024-06-29' AND order_date < DATE '2025-06-30' THEN line_revenue_eur ELSE 0 END)
            - SUM(CASE WHEN order_date >= DATE '2023-06-29' AND order_date < DATE '2024-06-29' THEN line_revenue_eur ELSE 0 END))
            / SUM(CASE WHEN order_date >= DATE '2023-06-29' AND order_date < DATE '2024-06-29' THEN line_revenue_eur ELSE 0 END) * 100.0
  END AS pct_change,
  (SUM(CASE WHEN order_date >= DATE '2024-06-29' AND order_date < DATE '2025-06-30' THEN line_revenue_eur ELSE 0 END)
    - SUM(CASE WHEN order_date >= DATE '2023-06-29' AND order_date < DATE '2024-06-29' THEN line_revenue_eur ELSE 0 END))
    / NULLIF(SUM(SUM(CASE WHEN order_date >= DATE '2024-06-29' AND order_date < DATE '2025-06-30' THEN line_revenue_eur ELSE 0 END)
                - SUM(CASE WHEN order_date >= DATE '2023-06-29' AND order_date < DATE '2024-06-29' THEN line_revenue_eur ELSE 0 END)) OVER (), 0) * 100.0 AS pct_contribution_to_total_change
FROM base
GROUP BY brand
ORDER BY abs_change_eur ASC

WITH product_contribution AS (
    SELECT 
        oi.product_id,
        p.brand,
        p.category,
        p.brand_tier,
        oi.platform,
        SUM(oi.unit_price_eur * oi.quantity) AS revenue_eur,
        SUM(oi.cost_eur * oi.quantity) AS cost_eur,
        SUM(oi.unit_price_eur * oi.quantity) - SUM(oi.cost_eur * oi.quantity) AS contribution_eur,
        CASE 
            WHEN SUM(oi.unit_price_eur * oi.quantity) = 0 THEN NULL
            ELSE ROUND((SUM(oi.unit_price_eur * oi.quantity) - SUM(oi.cost_eur * oi.quantity)) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(oi.unit_price_eur * oi.quantity), 0), 2)
        END AS contribution_margin_pct
    FROM luxexperience.order_items oi
    JOIN luxexperience.products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    WHERE oi.unit_price_eur IS NOT NULL
      AND oi.cost_eur IS NOT NULL
      AND oi.quantity IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY oi.product_id, p.brand, p.category, p.brand_tier, oi.platform
),
benchmark AS (
    SELECT 
        ROUND(AVG(contribution_margin_pct), 2) AS avg_contribution_margin_pct
    FROM product_contribution
    WHERE contribution_margin_pct IS NOT NULL
),
flagged AS (
    SELECT 
        pc.*,
        b.avg_contribution_margin_pct,
        ROUND(pc.contribution_margin_pct - b.avg_contribution_margin_pct, 2) AS margin_gap_pct,
        ROUND((pc.contribution_margin_pct - b.avg_contribution_margin_pct) * pc.revenue_eur / 100.0, 2) AS contribution_gap_eur
    FROM product_contribution pc
    CROSS JOIN benchmark b
    WHERE pc.contribution_margin_pct IS NOT NULL
      AND (pc.contribution_margin_pct < 0 OR pc.contribution_margin_pct < b.avg_contribution_margin_pct)
)
SELECT 
    'product' AS level,
    product_id AS entity_id,
    brand,
    category,

    contribution_margin_pct,
    avg_contribution_margin_pct AS benchmark_margin_pct,
    margin_gap_pct,
    contribution_gap_eur
FROM flagged
UNION ALL
SELECT 
    'brand' AS level,
    brand AS entity_id,

WITH order_base AS (
  SELECT 
    oi.order_id,
    oi.category,
    oi.brand_tier,
    oi.platform,
    MAX(oi.returned)::int AS has_return
  FROM luxexperience.order_items oi
  GROUP BY oi.order_id, oi.category, oi.brand_tier, oi.platform
),
return_reasons AS (
  SELECT 
    r.order_id,
    r.category,
    r.reason,
    COUNT(DISTINCT r.return_id) AS return_count
  FROM luxexperience.returns r
  GROUP BY r.order_id, r.category, r.reason
),
base_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    ob.category,
    ob.brand_tier,
    ob.platform,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ob.order_id) AS total_orders,
    SUM(ob.has_return) AS returned_orders,
    ROUND(SUM(ob.has_return) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT ob.order_id), 0), 2) AS return_rate_pct
  FROM order_base ob
  GROUP BY ob.category, ob.brand_tier, ob.platform
),
reason_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    ob.category,
    ob.brand_tier,
    ob.platform,
    rr.reason,
    COUNT(rr.return_count) AS reason_return_count
  FROM order_base ob
  LEFT JOIN return_reasons rr ON ob.order_id = rr.order_id AND ob.category = rr.category
  GROUP BY ob.category, ob.brand_tier, ob.platform, rr.reason
)
SELECT
  bm.category,
  bm.brand_tier,
  bm.platform,
  bm.total_orders,
  bm.returned_orders,
  bm.return_rate_pct,
  rm.reason,
  rm.reason_return_count
FROM base_metrics bm
LEFT JOIN reason_metrics rm
  ON bm.category = rm.category
